Class IntellijAsiContainer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.event.BasicPropertyChangeSource
uno.anahata.asi.AbstractAsiContainer
uno.anahata.asi.swing.AbstractSwingAsiContainer
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.IntellijAsiContainer
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.intellij.openapi.Disposable, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class IntellijAsiContainer extends AbstractSwingAsiContainer implements com.intellij.openapi.Disposable
Concrete implementation of the ASI Container for IntelliJ IDEA.

This container integrates the Anahata framework with the IntelliJ IDEA platform as an application-level singleton service, managing sessions, AI providers, and multi-window tool window tabs. Implements Disposable to ensure clean dynamic plugin unloading.

anahata

    • refreshOpenUiThemes

      private void refreshOpenUiThemes()
      Refreshes every open Anahata tool-window content after an IDE theme change, re-running the Swing UI delegates so components pick up the new light/dark palette.

      The authoritative dark-mode flag is read live via the detector registered in initEnvironment(), so newly built panels are already correct; this updates the panels that are currently on screen.

    • focusUI

      protected void focusUI(Agi agi)

      Focuses or creates a dedicated tab for the given AGI session. If the session is already open in any open project's tool window, that window and tab are brought to the front. Otherwise, a new tab is opened in the currently active or first open project window.

      Specified by:
      focusUI in class AbstractSwingAsiContainer
      Parameters:
      agi - the AGI session to focus or open.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()

      Shuts down all active AGI sessions without closing them or modifying their persisted open state, ensuring that session-level executor thread pools are terminated cleanly, then proceeds with the standard container shutdown.

      shutdown in class AbstractAsiContainer
